_note: WATCH DISPATCH corpus — the runner half of `<watch value= on:change=>` (the W12 stale-snapshot investigation). Pins the dispatch laws every renderer's view layer feeds: a watch NEVER fires on subscribe; it fires when its value MEANINGFULLY changed (JSE.watchKey — a deep-equal write is elided and never re-fires); the payload rides dsx.this (an object value as-is, else { value: … }); and — the filed bug — the handler observes the POST-WRITE store: every store read inside a watch handler sees the state that triggered the fire, never a pre-write snapshot. (Fire COUNT within one multi-write entry is renderer timing and stays unpinned — see watch-observes-settled-value-across-entry-writes.) Case `watch-entity-spelled-handler-holds-the-toggle` is the regression row for the 2026-08-17 starter toggle revert: the handler body spelled `&&` raw (attribute muscle memory in a code position) used to lex as `store & amp` and assign 0 over the just-clicked field (wave-7 F4, fixed by decodeOperatorEntities, jse/syntax-006); through the watch dispatch that 0 write REVERTED the toggle and was misdiagnosed as a stale store snapshot. Harnesses: watch-conformance.test.ts (TS, the store.watch primitive) · WatchConformanceTest.kt (Kotlin :core, the WatchView evaluate/fireWatch loop) · WatchConformance (Swift, ConformanceHosts.swift, record lane). Case shape = actions.json plus: `global` (app-wide store seed), `watches` [{ value, handler }], `pre` [{ path, value }] (bound-control writes landing before the entry — the toggle click's write), `expectGlobal` (dot-path asserts on the app-wide store).

cases.name: watch-handler-observes-post-write-store
cases._note: THE FILED SHAPE (STATE.md 2026-08-17, decoded spelling): a settings toggle writes its field, the field's on:change writes the app-wide store, and a mirror watch on that store writes the field back from a STORE read. The read must see the post-write world, so the mirror re-writes the value the click produced and the toggle HOLDS.

cases.name: watch-entity-spelled-handler-holds-the-toggle
cases._note: THE REGRESSION ROW — byte-for-byte the starter's authoring, `&&` spelled `&&` in a raw code body. Pre-F4 kernels lexed `store & amp` and assigned 0 over the just-clicked field (the observed toggle revert, misfiled as a stale snapshot); the shared preprocessor decode (jse/syntax-006) makes it the same logical-AND as the row above, THROUGH the watch dispatch path.

cases.name: watch-observes-settled-value-across-entry-writes
cases._note: An entry that writes the watched var twice settles with the handler having READ the final value from the store — the post-write law across multiple writes. The fire COUNT inside one multi-write entry is renderer timing and deliberately unpinned: the natives run the statements synchronously (one settled fire), the web runner awaits between statements (a fire per meaningfully-changed microtask tick). The terminal store state is the contract.
